claims.evidence: Witness report shows only the machine wrapped in clear plastic; no location/usage history details are visible.

claims.claim: The AR-M207 is packed with an extensive range of superb performance functions, delivering...
claims.evidence: No functional test, output, scanning/printing proof, or error-code/status screen is shown; only brand/model markings are visible.
Witness report states brand SHARP and model AR-M207 read from the front panel/model label in Photos 0–2.

risks.risk: Not confirmed working: copier/printer may not power on, may show errors, or may not copy/print properly (toner/drum/fuser issues).
risks.proof: A short video clip of the machine powering on and completing a test copy/print (showing the output page) with any error codes visible.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working/untested due to no power-on or output proof.

risks.risk: Consumables condition unknown (drum/toner/fuser life) which strongly affects value and repair cost.
risks.proof: A clear photo/screenshot of the machine’s status/consumables page (toner level and drum life/maintenance counters) and any service messages.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at worst-case consumable wear (as if toner/drum may be near end-of-life).

risks.risk: Physical damage or missing parts hidden by plastic wrap (dents, cracks, missing covers/trays, broken hinges).
risks.proof: Photos with the plastic removed showing all sides, front door area, paper trays, output tray, and any ports/covers; plus close-ups of corners/hinges.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially damaged/parts-missing until uncovered.

risks.risk: Accessories and cables may be missing (power cable, manuals, trays, network/scan accessories).
risks.proof: A laid-out inventory photo showing included items (power cable, all trays/covers, manuals, any network cable/adapters) with the machine serial/model visible.
risks.if_unproven: Priced assuming key accessories/cables may be missing.

risks.risk: Connectivity/ports may be non-functional or incomplete (USB/LAN/Wi‑Fi) affecting scanning/printing over network.
risks.proof: A photo of the rear/side ports plus a clip showing successful LAN/USB connection and a scan/print job completing.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as limited to basic/unknown connectivity until proven.

risks.risk: Page count/usage history unknown; high usage can mean higher wear and higher likelihood of service needs.
risks.proof: A photo/screenshot of the usage counters/page count screen.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at worst-case high usage (as if heavily used).

proof_requests: Power-on and test output video: show the machine starting and producing a clear copy/print page (with any error codes visible).
Photo/screenshot of consumables/status screen: toner level and drum/maintenance counters.
Photos with plastic removed: front, rear, both sides, paper trays, output tray, and close-ups of corners/hinges.
Inventory photo of included accessories: power cable, all trays/covers, manuals, and any network accessories.
Rear/side ports photo and a short clip showing a successful connection (LAN/USB) and a completed scan/print job.
response.reason: The witness can identify the model (SHARP AR-M207), but the machine’s working condition, consumables, and completeness are not shown because it is fully wrapped and no test results are provided. Without a power-on/test clip, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
